change.bound: 1..=8 lanes, validated; a failure on any lane fails the pipeline before anything is committed
change.invariants: every published file is still `fdatasync`ed exactly once; the commit's own barrier still closes the batch and fsyncs every remaining file and directory before the commit record; no frame, manifest, commit, index or identity byte changes
change.what: the early barrier's `fdatasync` work runs on `writeback_threads` lanes (default min(available_parallelism, 4); `wb1..wb8` selects)

floor.note: the 336 ms rung would need the embedding's read+encode chain to fall by about 138 ms; the writeback tail that dominated R22 is now hidden (215.1 ms busy under a 502.4 ms pipeline)
floor.rule: reader + encode_wall + (publish_wall - encode_wall) + commit on the least-contended shipped row; the early barrier is fully overlapped, so it is not on this path

identity.comparison: C-pipe4-wb1 vs C-pipe4-wb8, same fixture, same seeds, same chunk size
identity.object_ids_note: ObjectIds differ by design: the harness derives the object seed from the configuration name. The committed content roots, representation choice, byte counts and footprint are compared instead.
identity.unit_test: tests/tensor_pipeline.rs::writeback_lanes_do_not_change_a_single_byte asserts identical head, per-object ids and manifest bytes for 1 vs 8 lanes

losses: the rung is not met: 544.4 ms least-contended against 336 ms
RSS and CPU are unchanged by the lanes (the work is the same), so the change buys wall only
8 lanes is not separable from 4 on the median in this session (one 678.0 ms median sample against 579.3 ms); the least-contended values are 542.3 vs 544.4 ms
the host stalled in several repetitions (p95 is seconds); the paired/least-contended statistic is what the contract uses, and the raw samples are published

method.footprint_source: recursive file walk of the store directory
method.interleaving: seeded Fisher-Yates per repetition (seed 20261114) after the one-position rotation; every row runs once per repetition
method.limits: 3 GiB memory == swap, 1024 pids, 4 CPUs, bounded /tmp; unchanged
method.statistic: least-contended (min) is the contract statistic; median, p95 and p99 are published from the same seven samples

non_claims: single host, one writer, local POSIX backend, warm page cache
no media, power-loss, fleet, cloud or Go claim
the pipeline is a store-API path; no shipped CLI verb reaches it
